messages.subject: Community model without covariates
parts: How is a multispecies occupancy model that lacks both site-level and occasion-level covariates specified in camtrapR?

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Community model without covariates
parts:
Like this:

communityModel(
  data_list,
  model = c("Occupancy", "RN"),   # choose one
  occuCovs = list(fixed = NULL, independent = NULL, ranef = NULL),
  detCovs = list(fixed = NULL, ranef = NULL),
  detCovsObservation = list(fixed = NULL, ranef = NULL),
  speciesSiteRandomEffect = list(det = FALSE, occu = FALSE),
  intercepts = list(det = "fixed", occu = "fixed"),    # same intercept for all species.
  effortCov = "effort")

You will need to decide on the model (standard occupancy or Royle-Nichols). The default fixed intercept are constant across all species, which is probably not what you want. So consider setting intercepts to "ranef".
effortCov = "effort" does NOT include effort as a covariate on detection probability yet, but only uses the effort matrix to ensure that detection probability is 0 when there was no effort. See the help file ?communityModel for details.
